# Gastrointestinal

This folder catalogs the primary gastrointestinal conditions tracked by the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD). It covers the overarching clinical framework of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) alongside its two main subtypes, Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis. The pages detail national epidemiological estimates, registry inclusion criteria based on specific hospital contact codes, and demographic trends for both adult and pediatric populations in Denmark.

## Pages

- [[colitis-ulcerosa|Colitis ulcerosa]] — Details ulcerative colitis as a primary IBD subtype, including its DK51* diagnostic code, registry inclusion criteria, and epidemiological prevalence among newly diagnosed adults and children.
- [[crohns-sygdom|Crohns sygdom]] — Covers Crohn's disease (DK50*), highlighting its status as the most frequent pediatric IBD diagnosis, demographic trends among youth, and the clinical importance of post-operative follow-up.
- [[inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Inflammatoriske tarmsygdomme]] — Outlines the broader category of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), providing national prevalence estimates, overall hospital contact statistics, and its association with comorbidities like primary sclerosing cholangitis.
